decisions.rollback: snapshots capture every file's pre-edit state (existence + content); on any error each file is restored (rewritten or removed)
decisions.tempWrite: each file is written to a .bb-edit-<uuid> temp then renameSync'd atomically; temps are tracked and scrubbed on failure
decisions.failureInjection: rename to a language keyword (Python `class`) passes the identifier regex but yields invalid syntax, so validateFile throws after all writes — a faithful mid-operation failure

limitations: Rollback restores file content but cannot undo a cross-process concurrent edit that raced between planEdit and executeEdit (no file locking).
If renameSync itself fails on the first file, no later file is touched — the snapshot loop is a no-op for untouched files.
